check.description: Full quality pipeline: lint → format check → vulture → test+cov
check.prompt:
Run the quality pipeline in order, stopping on first failure:
1. uv run ruff check .
2. uv run ruff format --check .
3. uv run vulture libs apps tests
4. uv run pytest tests/ --cov=gex_common --cov=gex_receiver --cov=gex_worker --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=html --cov-fail-under=90

If any step fails, fix the issues and re-run until all pass.

fmt.description: Auto-fix lint issues and format code
fmt.prompt: Run `uv run ruff check --fix .` then `uv run ruff format .` to auto-fix lint and format issues.

lint.description: Check for lint issues and unused imports

vulture.prompt: Run `uv run vulture libs apps tests`
